title: Stop Saying "Very Stupid"! 4 Better Ways to Say It #shorts
description:
Don't say "very stupid". Say one of these instead:
• Idiotic: That's idiotic!
• Foolish: Feeding the bear was foolish.
• Absurd: Square wheels are an absurd idea.
• The idiom: I'm not the sharpest tool in the shed!
